metadata.dataset: Randolph Glacier Inventory 7.0 (RGI2000-v7.0-G), region 15 South Asia East
metadata.citation: RGI 7.0 Consortium, 2023. Randolph Glacier Inventory - A Dataset of Global Glacier Outlines, Version 7.0. Boulder, Colorado USA. NSIDC: National Snow and Ice Data Center. doi:10.5067/f6jmovy5navz
metadata.note: Each outline's source image date is in properties.src_date; RGI targets the year 2000 but individual outlines come from different years. RGI includes debris-covered ice; the Sentinel-2 NDSI composites in this project do not, so the two are not directly subtractable.
